profile.headline: Software Engineer 🌐View my portfolio==​> juliophp.com
profile.summary:
I embrace AI and modern technologies, but integrate them at deeper levels. I architect AI directly into system design, databases, and APIs. 

Advanced PHP and MySQL architecture combined with native LLM integration (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Mistral, etc.), real-time database intelligence, complex system orchestration. I can build what no-code tools cannot reach because I architect AI at the infrastructure level, not the surface. This requires deep knowledge of databases, backend systems, API design, and advanced code patterns. Same technology, exponentially more powerful.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I architect advanced AI systems through deep code engineering, not automation tools. Enterprise-grade solutions impossible with n8n or no-code builders. 🌐View my portfolio==​> juliophp.com

● FrescoLogic Ver 2: Architected an enterprise warehouse management platform
processing 23,000+ units monthly. Integrated native LLM APIs
(OpenAI/Claude/Gemini) directly into the core system design.

● AI-Database Orchestration: Developed a dual-module order system featuring a
context-aware natural language assistant and a real-time management dashboard for
intelligent fulfillment routing.

● High-Performance Backend: Engineered a pure PHP/MySQL stack with zero ORM
overhead, optimizing SQL queries and database-driven business logic for maximum
scalability.

● Infrastructure & Security: Deployed via AWS and Cloudflare (R2, DDoS protection,
CDN) to support complex orchestration for 76+ active corporate clients.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Manhattan, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
● Developed the entire frontend APP of the main project, transforming Figma designs into
a responsive, pixel-perfect UI in under two weeks.

● Collaborated closely with design and backend teams to deliver features with a seamless
UI/UX experience.

● Designed, developed, and implemented AI-powered systems, including:
○ Chatbot assistant to support user inquiries.
○ License data extraction app using AI to process driver’s license information in
seconds.
○ Image and icon generator with DALL-E to automatically create visuals for
vehicle listings and system assets.
○ Database + AI integration for automated reporting and statistical insights.

● Supported backend development using PHP and MySQL.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
Led the design and development of FrescoLogic, a logistics management platform for Fresco Products.
Built features including order tracking, delivery coordination, and route management.

.-Developed a QuickBooks API integration automating invoicing and order processing.

.-Created a real-time SSE dashboard for warehouse TV screens, streamlining daily operations.

.-Delivered mobile-optimized tools for warehouse staff, improving on-site efficiency.

.-Managed the full SDLC from requirements gathering to deployment and maintenance.

.-Platform operated daily for 4+ years, processing 700,000+ records in MySQL.

.-Designed backend infrastructure enabling dynamic QR code generation and NFC tag configuration.

.-Built RESTful APIs and MySQL schema for user-managed content redirection via QR and NFC.

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Development of Web Platforms for Major Infrastructure Projects:

.-Odebrecht Panama (Multiple Sectors): Developed a web platform that integrated with Oracle PeopleSoft, connecting to the human resources database to support various company sectors across multiple projects in Panama.

.-Bocas del Toro Hydroelectric Power Plant: Created and launched a platform for the issuance, verification, validation, approval, distribution, and revision control of documents and plans. This platform facilitated communication with external designers, covering the entire process until a document or plan was approved. It replaced an external corporate application, resulting in savings of $80,000 to $200,000 in licensing, training, and implementation costs.

.-Pan American Highway, Santiago-Viguí Section: Developed an application for plan control and a system to generate and manage delivery guides for plans.

.-Tocumen International Airport Expansion: Designed and developed a comprehensive web platform with over 20 modules supporting various project sectors, including Human Resources, Finance, Administration, Quality Management, and HSE. Additionally, I developed a system for personal protective equipment (PPE) management, achieving over 40% cost reduction in PPE purchases during the first month of system implementation.

.-Cinta Costera Phase 3 - Highway: Developed a web platform with over 20 modules, managing more than 25,000 documents over two years. This platform played a key role in securing ISO 9001 certification. The inspection control module for the marine section was highly praised by external auditors during certification. I also created a high-security module to provide the client, the Ministry of Public Works (MOP), with controlled access to project information and documentation.

positions.title: Application Software Developer
positions.locationName: Venezuela - HYDROELECTRIC POWER PLANT – 5.996 MM US$
positions.description:
I single-handedly developed, implemented, and maintained a high-performance web platform without a dedicated development team or external support. This platform successfully managed over 15 critical IT applications, supporting an operation with more than 6,500 employees.

Key applications included:

.-Document Control System (SISCODOC) for the company's Quality Management System.

.-Measurement Equipment Control, Record Management, Equipment Maintenance System, and Personal Protective Equipment Control.

.-Management and statistical tracking for the Concrete, Soils, and Asphalt laboratory, among other essential functions.

.-Additionally, I provided comprehensive support and assistance to the Quality Management, Engineering, HSE, and Commercial departments, ensuring seamless operations across the organization.
